projects.title: KOBANIQ
projects.subtitle: AI career intelligence for job seekers
projects.summary: KOBANIQ is an AI-powered career intelligence platform that helps job seekers in Somalia and Somaliland evaluate their skills, discover relevant job opportunities, prepare for interviews and build tailored CVs.
projects.problem:
Job seekers in Somalia and Somaliland often struggle to identify jobs that genuinely match their skills, understand what different positions require, evaluate their actual technical abilities and prepare competitive CVs and interviews.

Existing job-search approaches offer little guidance on skill gaps, career readiness or personalised preparation, leaving job seekers unsure what to improve and how to approach the right opportunities.
projects.solution: KOBANIQ brings AI-powered skill assessment, job intelligence, personalised CV generation and interview preparation together in one mobile app. It verifies skills with adaptive quizzes, explains why each job matches a profile, highlights the skills that are missing, writes job-specific CVs only from the user's own profile and lets users practise interviews with feedback on every answer.
projects.features:
AI Skill Assessment: Adaptive quizzes check the skills users claim and return an assessed level with strengths, weaknesses and recommendations.
Job Intelligence: Researches jobs from configured sources and explains every match with a score and the skill gaps to close.
AI-Powered CV Builder: Generates job-specific CVs from the job description and the user's own profile, ready to export as a PDF.
Interview Preparation: Practise technical and behavioural interviews with AI-generated questions and feedback on each answer.
Career Insights: One place to see skills, assessments, progress and recommendations for improving career readiness.
Notifications: Relevant job alerts and application-related updates, delivered to the phone.
